## Details

<a id="irq_handler"></a>
### [`irq_handler`](../../../../src/irq/irq.asm#L6) `$0943`

*routine*

IRQ handler. With raster_split_enable set and a raster interrupt, it makes the menu screen splits: from line 0 white background and multicolour, from line $b2 hires, from line $ca mix_colour as background. Else (the CIA 1 timer): UDTIM, the pad read, the button state, the menu flash, the idle tick sound, the cursor colour and SCNKEY, each when its flag is set.

- **Calls:** [`UDTIM`](../../memory-map.md#UDTIM), [`read_pad_registers`](irq.md#read_pad_registers), [`irq_flash`](irq.md#irq_flash), [`play_beep`](../sound/beep.md#play_beep), [`irq_cursor_colour`](irq.md#irq_cursor_colour), [`SCNKEY`](../../memory-map.md#SCNKEY)
- **Reads:** [`raster_split_enable`](../../memory-map.md#raster_split_enable), [`VICIRQ`](../../memory-map.md#VICIRQ), [`RASTER`](../../memory-map.md#RASTER), [`mix_colour`](../../memory-map.md#mix_colour), [`SCROLX`](../../memory-map.md#SCROLX), [`CIAICR`](../../memory-map.md#CIAICR), [`CIAPRB`](../../memory-map.md#CIAPRB), [`button_held`](../../memory-map.md#button_held), [`flash_enable`](../../memory-map.md#flash_enable), [`off_pad_beep_on`](../../memory-map.md#off_pad_beep_on), [`idle_tick_timer`](../../memory-map.md#idle_tick_timer), [`cursor_colour_enable`](../../memory-map.md#cursor_colour_enable) and 1 more
- **Writes:** [`BGCOL0`](../../memory-map.md#BGCOL0), [`RASTER`](../../memory-map.md#RASTER), [`SCROLX`](../../memory-map.md#SCROLX), [`button_press_edge`](../../memory-map.md#button_press_edge), [`button_held`](../../memory-map.md#button_held), [`idle_tick_timer`](../../memory-map.md#idle_tick_timer), [`VICIRQ`](../../memory-map.md#VICIRQ)

### [`read_pad_registers`](../../../../src/irq/irq.asm#L108) `$09F8`

*routine*
